title: Expedited rollout paths with risk-scored approvals and signer rotation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Production model promotions (canary, A/B, and shadow) require manual sign-offs and static approval flows which slow down critical security patches and urgent model fixes. Current flows don't support signer rotation, ephemeral approvals for low-risk changes, or automated escalations when approvers are unavailable. We need a policy-driven approval engine that assigns dynamic approval paths based on risk score, supports short-lived expedited paths, enforces signer rotation windows, and emits immutable evidence bundles into audit logs for forensic review.

Scope: Design and deliver a product-level approval workflow that integrates with:
- rollout orchestration (canary/A-B/shadow)
- RBAC in Console and Private deployments
- audit event store and immutable evidence bundles
- auto-rollback triggers tied to rollout metrics and sign-off expiration

Out of scope (for this ticket): deep RBAC IAM rewrites for on-prem installs (follow-up ENG epic), and long-term attestation ledger persistence beyond 90 days (separate compliance backlog).
acceptance_criteria: Policy engine can evaluate a change request and return an approval path containing a sequence of signer roles and time windows
Console UI shows dynamic signer list and allows operator to request expedited path with justification (ttl <= 4 hours)
Audit evidence bundle (request payload, model version, rollout config, risk score, approver IDs, decision timestamps) is written to the audit log as an immutable artifact for every promotion
Signer rotation enforced: each listed approver must not be the same identity for two consecutive signoffs where rotation is required by policy
Automated escalation triggers when primary approver does not respond within configured window and notifies secondary approvers and on-call via existing alerting integration
Auto-rollback executes if canary error volume exceeds threshold OR if an approval TTL expires without required signoffs
End-to-end tests covering: policy evaluation, expired-ttl rollback, expedited TTL path, evidence bundle correctness, and audit log indexing
Security review sign-off obtained and documented in Confluence before release
